title: Polly and the Whisper Puppet
youtube_title: Polly and the Whisper Puppet | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a clear small voice that stays to the end of the line.
summary: Polly wants to welcome friends with a mouse puppet, but her voice hides. She and Jalen practice a gentle duet on the rug, and Polly speaks her line clearly for a small audience.
